verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe a single Checkout API integration (sessions or paymentMethods/payments) that surfaces cards, wallets, and local payment methods together, and independent hands-on community feedback confirms it delivered 'every payment option under the sun' including native local methods like iDEAL and Sofort from one integration. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming Apple Pay/Google Pay/BNPL methods specifically (only generic 'wallets and local payment methods' language is present) and no independent confirmation of BNPL support.
